name: Bears the Mark of the Old Ones
description: You were once part of a cult dedicated to ancient cosmic entities. Though you've left that life behind, the eldritch influence still clings to you.
connectionOptions: One PC helped you escape from the cult.
You sense that one PC has a destiny intertwined with cosmic forces.
One PC is investigating your former cult, unaware of your past involvement.
You're protecting one PC from the cult's interest in them.
additionalEquipment: Eldritch symbol amulet (which you can't bring yourself to discard)
Dream journal filled with prophetic nightmares

abilities.name: Eldritch Resistance
abilities.description: Your exposure to cosmic forces has changed you. You have +2 Armor against damage from otherworldly sources.

abilities.name: Dark Whispers
abilities.description: You can communicate telepathically with willing creatures within short range.

abilities.name: Unsettling Presence
abilities.description: Your aura unsettles normal people. You're trained in intimidation tasks against non-cultists.

abilities.name: Cosmic Insight
abilities.description: Once per day, you can tap into cosmic knowledge to gain an asset on a non-combat task of your choice.

abilities.name: Eldritch Transformation
abilities.description: You can temporarily transform part of your body in disturbing ways (e.g., growing tentacles, extra eyes). This provides an asset to a physical task but risks Intellect damage.

abilities.name: Void Walk
abilities.description: Once per day, you can step into one shadow and emerge from another within long range.

abilities.name: Call of the Old Ones
abilities.description: Once per session, you can attempt to call upon the power of cosmic entities. This can produce powerful effects but comes with great risk and potential madness.
